svg.text: It was almost dark when Nina heard a quiet noise behind the garden fence. She stopped
and listened. Something was crying. Carefully, she opened the gate and found a small
brown dog with a torn ear. It was shaking from cold.
"Poor thing," she whispered, wrapping the dog in her scarf. "Where do you live?" But
the dog could only look at her with big, sad eyes.
Nina carried it home and gave it some warm milk. The next morning she put up notices
on lampposts all over the neighbourhood. For three days nobody called. On the fourth
day, an elderly man knocked at the door. When the dog saw him, it jumped into his arms
and would not stop wagging its tail. "I thought I had lost him forever," the man said,
Nina smiled. She was happy for them, but she felt a little sad as well.
